newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent trades lower on weak API statistics.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent trades lower on weak API statistics.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude futures traded lower on Wednesday afternoon amid bearish weekly American Petroleum Institute (API) crude and products data, brokers said.
"It basically tracking the API data, but there is not much activity," one broker said.
Latest API figures showed that crude oil stocks have risen by nearly 3 million barrels, distillates by 2.6 million barrels and gasoline by a hefty 3.6 million barrels.
June Brent last traded at $17.98 per barrel, down 16 cents from its last close in London at $18.14, after recording 95 lots. July last traded at $18.15, down 17 cents, after registering 25 lots.
Brokers asssessed June support on SIMEX at $17.90 a barrel.
NYMEX crude on ACCESS last traded at $19.60 per barrel down 23 cents from its last official close.
